artworks.title: A Sculpture of Saint Benedict in a Niche
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with touches of white chalk on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man standing in a niche. He is dressed in robes with a hood, holding a staff in his right hand and an open book in his left hand. A small winged figure sits beside him, holding a shield. The background features an arched structure.

artworks.title: Two Male Figures: A Youth and an Old Man
artworks.medium: black and red chalk, with white heightening on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two people, depicted from the knees up. The person in the foreground is positioned slightly to the right, with their body leaning towards the left, creating a diagonal alignment. This person has a head of curly hair and their facial features are softly defined. They are wearing a light-colored tunic tied at the waist with a darker fabric. Draped over their shoulders is a flowing, reddish cloak. Behind this individual, another person is visible, positioned slightly behind with their face turned towards the left. This second figure appears to be older, with less hair. Both figures are elegantly posed, and they are intertwined in posture. The surrounding background is a plain, textured surface, and there are no visible objects or jewelry specified within the frame. The image has an unfinished quality.

artworks.title: A Roman Capriccio with the Pyramid of Gaius Cestius
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, with brown and gray-brown wash over black chalk counterproof on laid paper
artworks.description: A drawing of an ancient Roman structure with a fountain and sculptures. The image features a large, pyramid-like mausoleum structure in the background. In the foreground, there is a sculpted fountain with a reclining figure and a lion's head from where water flows. A dog interacts with the water, while two women talk beside the fountain. Additional sculptural elements can be seen on the structure, including a human figure relief. Natural elements like shrubs and stones are present in the scene.

artworks.title: Aurora's Tryst with Time Interrupted
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and red wash, red and black chalk, heightened with white gouache on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of an allegorical scene featuring two figures. The composition is energetic, with sweeping lines and a sense of motion. The painting is done in sepia tones with loose, cursive lines. The figures are surrounded by swirling shapes and partial impressions of elements.

artworks.title: Achilles and Patroclus
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and brown-gray wash on laid paper

artworks.title: A Seated Nude
artworks.medium: red chalk with incising on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two faceless figures in a dynamic posture. The figures are rendered in reddish-brown chalk on paper. One figure is seated on a low platform or block, while the other appears partially obscured behind the first figure. The focus is on the muscular structure and form of the figures, likely intended for study or practice in rendering human anatomy. The use of line and shading highlights the details and contours of the muscles and limbs.

artworks.title: A Reclining Male Nude
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a nude adult male figure reclining with his back against an elevated surface. His head is tilted upwards, eyes closed, with defined facial features including a prominent nose. He has long, wavy hair and a muscular physique. A white drapery partially covers his mid-section. In the background, there is a detailed depiction of a cloudy sky in fine linework. The artwork is rendered in monochrome sepia tones.

artworks.title: Figures on a Roman Piazza
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of an urban scene, possibly a city square, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. Several figures are depicted in faint outlines against the backdrop of monumental buildings. On the right, there is a tall column with a statue on top, surrounded by detailed architectural structures. The horizon is indicated by distant rooftops above the figures. The sketch includes soft shading and precise lines to convey texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using different shades of graphite to depict light and shadow.

artworks.title: Caricatures of Clerics and Priests
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 14.1 x 18.6 cm (5 9/16 x 7 5/16 in.), irregularly torn and repaired
artworks.description: The drawing shows various figures with different levels of body visibility. The central figure is depicted in profile, wearing a hat and with detailed facial features. They have curly hair peeking out from the hat. Beside them, another figure faces them with open hands. On the right side, there are multiple figures with head coverings resembling hats. The figures have long noses and exaggerated chins. Simple lines and hatching are used for texture and shadow. Some figures have fabric or patterns on their clothing near the waist. The background is plain with light sketching marks visible.

artworks.title: The Immaculate Conception
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with black chalk on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (rounded top): 28.4 x 15.1 cm (11 3/16 x 5 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features three individuals in a line drawing within an arched frame. The central figure stands slightly elevated, hands on chest, with a halo of stars around their head. They wear draped robes. Flanking them are two seated individuals, one with curly hair and a beard holding a slender object, and the other with a tonsured hairstyle in a prayerful pose wearing monastic robes. The background shows minimalist outlines of clouds or mist.

artworks.title: Egyptian Stage Design
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient architectural scene from a slightly elevated viewpoint. A large pyramid is on the left, with precise lines indicating individual stone blocks. Staircases lead towards the pyramid, flanked by sphinx-like statues. Classical columns are on the right, supporting a diagonal stone structure with vegetation on top. In the distance, a large, tiered wall with geometric patterns runs along the horizon. The artwork is detailed with ink outlines and a sepia wash, using a limited brown color palette.

artworks.title: Allegory of Justice
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with violet-brown wash over black chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in classical attire. The image shows three figures dressed in flowing garments. The central figure wears a helmet with a plume and holds a staff or another long object. The figures are drawn with strong outlines and shaded with a monochromatic wash, giving them volume and depth. Delicate lines are used to detail the features and clothing, emphasizing the graceful postures and implied interaction between the figures.

artworks.title: Travelers on a Wooded Path with a Border of Whimsical Figures and Monkeys
artworks.medium: watercolor and black ink over black chalk on wove paper, with gold paper border and graphite framing lines
artworks.dimensions: sheet (inverted fan shape): 24.9 x 34.2 cm (9 13/16 x 13 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a painting of a path flanked by tall trees. The horizon is obscured by the trees arching over the path. Two figures are walking away on the path, one in blue and the other in red. The brushstrokes are loose and expressive, especially in the foliage and tree trunks. The color palette includes earthy tones of green and brown, with accents of blue in the sky and decorative border around the scene.

artworks.title: A Woman Combing Her Hair in Front of a Mirror
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The sketch shows two individuals. One is seated with long hair falling down their back, while the other is partially visible in a mirror, with short hair and a hand raised near or above their head. The sketch is in line art with minimal detail in the surroundings.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Natural Arch
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash and watercolor over traces of graphite and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a natural rocky landscape with a stone arch in the center where two small figures are walking. The view is slightly elevated, with large rock formations, dense foliage, and hints of a bright sky in the distance. The brushstrokes are detailed yet fluid, capturing the texture of rocks, trees, and foliage. The color palette includes earthy tones like browns, grays, and muted greens. On the right side, trees frame the composition, and figures are seen below the archway. The textures and natural elements provide depth in the painting.

artworks.title: A Baldachin with a Painting of the Annunciation
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on two jointed sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a complex arrangement of swirling lines and ornate shapes that form a series of arches and columns. In this abstract sketch, the curving lines and elaborate details resemble the grandeur of a classical architectural structure, with elements that evoke the image of a grandiose altar or stage. Figures positioned on and around the curves represent human forms, suggesting a historical and artistic scene. Flanking the central archway, there are figures that remind one of statues typically found adorning the facades of cathedrals or the interiors of grand opera houses, infusing the composition with movement and stability.

artworks.title: A Heroic Male Nude
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a muscular figure standing with crossed arms. The drawing is done in a sketchy, freehand style with visible lines emphasizing the musculature and form of the figure. The perspective is from a low angle. The figure's stance is strong, with one foot placed forward. The background is plain. The use of line work effectively captures the tension and definition of the muscles.

artworks.title: Cows and Sheep under Trees
artworks.medium: charcoal and white chalk with touches of red chalk on blue-gray laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with cows walking along a pathway bordered by trees. The point of view is slightly above. The horizon is implied with distant trees and figures as visual boundaries. The artwork has a sketch-like quality with loose brushstrokes for texture and movement. The color palette is earthy with gray, brown, and hints of rust and white. There is a tree line in the distance and the path and animals create a sense of rural life in the foreground.

artworks.title: Abbot Antonio Niccolini
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile with distinct facial features such as a prominent nose and chin. He has curly hair flowing towards the nape of his neck and is wearing historical clothing including a long coat, trousers, and heeled shoes. He stands upright with his hands clasped behind his back. The background is simple with horizontal lines indicating a surface.

artworks.title: Bernhard's Whooping Cough Face
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a person in profile, seated and facing right. The individual has short hair, a small nose, and a smooth face. They wear a garment with a high collar and lapel, possibly a coat, with a hint of a scarf around the neck. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies with Figures, Hands, and Feet
artworks.medium: red and white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various figure and limb studies on a single sheet. The drawing features sketches of multiple anatomical studies, including full figures, arms, hands, and feet in various poses and perspectives. The drawing is rendered in brownish-red chalk on a blue-grey paper background. The signature at the bottom indicates that it is in the style of Carlo Maratti, showcasing a focus on musculature and gestures in the studies.

artworks.title: An Italian Coast Scene
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal landscape with rocky cliffs, buildings, greenery, and the sea. The horizon is high in the composition, with a distant mountain or hill. The watercolor technique displays subtle brushstrokes and a color palette of earth tones, grays, green, and pale blue-gray.

artworks.title: Pompeiian Wall Decoration
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with  gray and brown wash and pen and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative room interior featuring a stylized and ornate wall design. The wall includes a doorway in the center, blue diamond shapes with white vase motifs, intricate patterns of foliage and florals, a black and gold sconce, birds, a small figure or object, and carved details on the vaults above.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink over black chalk on laid paper; with irregularly cut and torn patches attached and drawn with compositional corrections in pen and brown ink and black chalk
artworks.description: This image depicts a group of muscular figures engaging in an intense encounter. The composition is dynamic, with several figures surrounding a central horizontal figure on a table. The figures are sketched with strong lines, conveying tension and emotion. The scene takes place in a sparse interior space, with additional faint sketches of figures in the top right corner.
